updates.closure_rationale: Actual retained ad_packet preserves HEADER/KIND/LENGTH/ACK distinctions and borrowed payload, with cursor composition and full65535-byte payload boundary. The unmodified supplied census C++23 example is actually compiled/executed; its wrapper ABI observations and inspected borrowed-lifetime premise are compared without treating its source as normative C++ authority. C tag/status and C++ variant/expected/span do not pin backing storage. The explicit error/state tables reach subtraction only after valid header extents. Contiguous parsing copies no payload, performs no allocation/overlay/unaligned integer load and calls actual FCursor/f_take. Packet construction uses actual f_checked_size. The ring invariant maps logical offsets to occupied physical bytes and excludes all producer writes from the held envelope until release; output publication is after refusal checks. Six GCC/Clang debug/release/ASan+UBSan profiles compare26080 independent contiguous/ring byte cases and32774 ownership histories/163894 transitions. Each rejects8 compiled semantic controls, including actual retained MOD19/20; four compiling learner anchors reject normally. Actual hs_read_frame is exercised through local one-byte pipe writes, every selected truncated EOF, empty/oversized outer frames and exact inner extent. Actual ar_encode/ar_decode version1/2 signed records cross a wrap-split payload. Compiler dependency closures bind these providers, not substitute models. The changed-condition implementation retains a fixed-address owner/generation token across cancellation and close; every physical origin, stale/foreign/duplicate token, MAX issuance/retirement and capacity exclusion is tested. Segmented borrowing and copied payloads use the same release/cancellation semantics, repeated10000-frame runs and equal4930000 checksum. Full thirteen-dimension analysis, strict helper audits, actual representation and build observations are supplied. Multiple simultaneous consumers are explicitly outside this single-consumer protocol and supply a counterexample to overgeneralization, not a falsely implemented claim. Bounded author support; no unaided delayed learner result or non-author assessment inferred.
